title: Transit fare calculator with caps (AI-only run task L3)

content.audience: Synthetic study task for the thesis AI-only run: a transit agency checking card charges
content.problem_statement: Charge a list of transit trips by card: zone fares, free transfers, concession fares, daily and weekly caps and an airport surcharge outside the caps, then print each card's trips and totals. This is a frozen synthetic task for the thesis AI-only run, not a customer product.

user_flows.name: Charge trips
steps: Pipe the trip list into the CLI
Read each card's charged trips and totals

user_flows.name: Transfers and caps
steps: Take several trips in a day and a week
Read which trips were transfers or capped

user_flows.name: Bad input
steps: Pipe a bad line or pass a bad argument
Read the error and the exit status

scope: Python 3.8+ standard library only, entry point src/main.py, all code under src

Required structure: a package src/fares with __init__.py and the modules network, taps, pricing, caps, report and cli, each with at least one top-level function (a def at module level; a def only inside a class does not count)
src/main.py imports from fares and each module is imported by main.py or by another module of the package
Run as python3 -I src/main.py, which does not put src on the import path: main.py must add its own directory to sys.path before importing fares
Stations and zones: central, market and harbor are zone 1; north, east and mill zone 2; airport and lakeside zone 3; ridge zone 4
Read all of stdin and split it into lines on \n, numbered from 1 counting every line. Split each line into whitespace-separated fields; skip a line with no fields or whose first field starts with #

Each other line is a trip: CARD DAY HH:MM FROM TO, exactly five fields. CARD is A or C followed by exactly 3 digits (C cards are concession cards). DAY is 1 to 28 without leading zeros. HH:MM has two-digit hours 00 to 23 and minutes 00 to 59. FROM and TO are different known stations
Trips must be in non-decreasing (DAY, HH:MM) order across the whole list. For the first line that breaks a rule print exactly error: line N, print nothing else, and exit 1
Fare: 2.00 plus 0.75 for each zone between FROM and TO (the difference of their zone numbers). A concession card pays half of that, rounded half up to the cent (for example 2.75 becomes 1.38)

Transfer: a trip is a transfer, and its fare is 0.00, when the same card's latest non-transfer trip was on the same day and started at most 60 minutes before it. A transfer never starts a new 60-minute window

Caps: per card, the fares charged on one day add up to at most 7.00, and in one week at most 25.00, where days 1-7 are week 1, 8-14 week 2, 15-21 week 3 and 22-28 week 4. A concession card's caps are 3.50 and 12.50. A trip is charged the smallest of its fare and what is left of each cap
Airport surcharge: a trip from or to airport costs 1.50 more, the same for every card. The surcharge is charged even when the caps are reached and does not count toward them
A trip's charge is its capped fare plus any surcharge. A trip is marked capped when its capped fare is less than its fare (so never when the fare is 0.00)

Output per card, cards in plain string order: CARD: N trips, total X.XX (1 trip when N is 1), then one line per trip in input order: two spaces, DAY HH:MM FROM>TO X.XX, followed by any of the words transfer, capped, airport that apply, in that order, each after one space
Then a last line: cards N, total X.XX over the cards printed. With no trip lines print exactly: no trips. Each output line ends with \n. Amounts have exactly two decimals. Exit 0

--card ID (a valid card id) prints only that card's lines and counts only that card in the last line; every input line is still checked. Any other arguments print exactly: invalid arguments, then \n, and exit 2
All money is exact cents; no floating point. No files, network, environment variables or third-party packages
